## Design

Counts $y_i \sim \text{Poisson}(\exp(b_0 + x_i^\top \beta))$ with background rate $\lambda_0 = e^{b_0} \in \{0.01, 1, 10, 100\}$.
Each causal effect is calibrated to $E[\text{LRT}] = T \in \{8, 12, 16, 20, 24\}$ for its own column at that rate (`calibrate_rate.py`), so detectability is matched along $\lambda_0$.

- Multi-effect: 3 equal causals, `gap` 8 (correlated) or 64 (independent) columns apart, fit $L = 5$.
- Single effect (`-ser`): one causal at column 64, fit $L = 1$.
- Arms, all scored in Q2 with an EB prior variance: CAVI-Q2 (exact closed-form offset), gIBSS-Q2 (plug-in mean offset), score (one Newton step from the intercept-only null).
- 200 replicates per cell. Declared = 95% CS of a component with SER log BF $\geq 2$.

| design | $X$ | causal set size |
|---|---|---|
| gaussian | AR1 Gaussian, $n = 500$, $p = 256$, $\rho = 0.9$ | dense |
| binary | binary Markov, $n = 1000$, $p = 256$, corr 0.8, density 0.1 | ~100 |
| block | nested attrition (024's), $n = 1000$, causals at depth 3 | ~83 |

Figure rows, each relative to CAVI-Q2 on the same simulated data:
**coverage** = arm minus CAVI fraction of declared CSs containing a causal;
**power** = arm minus CAVI fraction of causals inside some declared CS;
**CS size ratio** = mean declared-CS size, arm over CAVI;
**ELBO** = gIBSS minus CAVI common Q2 ELBO, mean per fit (score omitted: its Q2 ELBO reaches about $-10^{15}$ at $\lambda_0 = 0.01$).
Bands are 95% CIs from resampling replicates jointly for both arms.

Table columns, CAVI-Q2's own values pooled over $T$:
**coverage** = covering / declared CSs;
**power** = captured causals / causals;
**mean CS size** = mean size of declared CSs;
**declared CSs** = count over all reps;
**reps** = replicate fits pooled.
